subject: Offer band & level sign-off needed for candidate Alex Jenkins — cross-team input
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Offer band & level sign-off needed for candidate Alex Jenkins — cross-team input

Team —

We have momentum with Alex Jenkins (ex-Scale infra/observability) for a senior backend role. Recruiter Sarah sent a strong CV; candidate's comps signal Staff-level comp in-market, but the hiring manager (Monica) thinks L5 IC with a fast promotion path is appropriate. We need a quick alignment on:

- Final level (L4/L5/L6 or manager track)
- Base + sign-on + equity target within band (we have budget constraints for Q3)
- Headcount approval confirmation (req REQ-2026-1183 is in play)

Context: Monica prefers IC track; Marcus may push higher given scale experience. Laura — can you confirm available band headroom for an L5 in ENG-BACKEND and whether a discretionary signing bonus is allowed under the current comp policy?

I attached the current comp band table for reference. I can circulate an offer draft once we have a level and band number. If we don't align by EOD tomorrow, candidate will expect an answer and may accept another offer.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
[karthik_iyer@redwood.ai]

[Attachment: comp-band-reference.pdf (PDF)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-01T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer band & level sign-off needed for candidate Alex Jenkins — cross-team input

Karthik —

Quick read: comp-band-reference.pdf attached has the latest bands. Short answers:

- L4: below market for this profile.
- L5 (Senior Engineer): fits 70% of the experience signals; base band mid-to-high depends on location (we're in SF comp table).
- L6 (Staff): candidate would need demonstrated leadership across teams and prior Staff title to justify L6; market comps are ~20-25% higher than L5.

Signing bonus: allowed up to one month base as a discretionary sign-on for critical hires; requires manager + finance sign-off. Equity: up to the midpoint of L5 band without exec approval; above that needs VP signoff.

Headcount: REQ-2026-1183 is approved in principle for Q3 but flagged for finance clearance on July 5. If you want to proceed before finance clears, we can do a conditional offer (contingent on final HC approval) but that will reduce leverage.

Recommended path: Offer as L5 IC, base at upper-mid of L5 band + 1x month sign-on + 0.25% RSU grant (typical for senior backend lateral). If Marcus believes Alex is Staff-level, give specific evidence (past org chart, scope) so we can consider an L6 exception.

Laura Bennett
Head of Total Rewards, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

[Attachment: comp-band-reference.pdf (PDF)]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-02T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer band & level sign-off needed for candidate Alex Jenkins — cross-team input

Thanks everyone — quick note from the hiring manager side.

Alex ran our architecture interview loop and led a take-home that mapped cleanly to our infra challenges (multi-tenant KV cache, rolling upgrades). He was the de facto tech lead at his last company on a similar scale — owned cross-team technical decisions, mentored 3+ engineers, and partnered with product. He does not currently have the title "Staff" but his scope matches.

My ask: Extend an L5 IC offer with explicit L6 growth plan tied to two objectives (cross-team rollout + observability ownership) and a six-month checkpoint that includes a structured calibration review for promotion. That keeps IC track while addressing Marcus's concern about scope.

If we go this route, I'm happy to sign the comp request and communicate growth plan to the candidate. Also OK with the 1x month sign-on Laura suggested.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Eng Manager, Backend Services
monica_patel@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer band & level sign-off needed for candidate Alex Jenkins — cross-team input

Appreciate the data. Two quick points from POV of org-level consistency:

1) If a candidate has de-facto Staff scope (even without title), we should consider either paying L6 band or documenting a concrete calibration rubric for a guaranteed promotion timeline. Avoid repeated "promotion promises" without measurable milestones.

2) If we proceed with L5 + fast-promo path, I want the promised milestones captured in Workday/OKR and a note in the comp approval record so Talent + Finance can track any retrospective comp actions.

Evelyn — can you confirm whether the approval record can include a time-bound promotion clause (e.g., review after 6 months) and whether Finance will reserve band headroom for that potential uplift?

Marcus Lin
VP, Engineering
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-02T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer band & level sign-off needed for candidate Alex Jenkins — cross-team input

Marcus / team —

We can approve the L5 IC offer with the following explicit conditions:

- Base: up to $200,000 (SF-adjusted) within L5 band
- Sign-on: 1x month base (discretionary)
- Equity: 0.25% RSU grant up to L5 midpoint
- Promotion clause: formal six-month calibration roadmap documented in Workday; Talent will create a Promotion Plan task and Finance will provision a contingent headcount uplift of up to 10% comp budgeted for the role pending promotion.

Please attach the Promotion Plan doc to the comp-approval-record.csv when you route to Finance. I have uploaded the offer-letter-template.docx and created an approval row in the comp spreadsheet. Approving now so Karthik can extend.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Talent Operations, Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.ai

Alex / Sarah —

Forwarding the internal alignment thread. Short version: we are extending an L5 IC offer with the following headline terms (subject to standard background checks):

- Base: $195,000 (SF equivalent)
- Sign-on: $16,250 (1x month base)
- Equity: 0.25% RSU grant with standard four-year vesting
- Promotion plan: documented six-month calibration with measurable milestones for potential uplift to L6; Talent & Finance have provisioned contingent uplift.

Monica and I will send the formal offer letter (using the template attached) within two hours. Please let us know if you have any timing/notice constraints — we would like a signed response within 5 business days.

Thanks and welcome — excited to move forward.
